title: Add a response header
summary: NestJS: Add a response header. Use curl -i to see Cache-Control: no-store.
introduction: @Header adds metadata to a response. Open GET /note and inspect its Cache-Control header.
learningObjectives: Add a response header with NestJS
Use curl -i to see Cache-Control: no-store

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Add a response header

blocks.text: The Header decorator adds no-store before Nest sends the text.
Use curl -i to see Cache-Control: no-store.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Headers must be set before a response is sent.
